Author: Kagekazu
Name: RelicTracker
Punchline: Track relic progress and materials across inventory and retainers.
Description: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job. Owned relic detection and live material counts from Allagan Tools (replicas included). Optional FFXIV Collect sync for relics you no longer have.
Changelog:
- Gather & Chill: each gatherable row now has a Gather button, plus a Stop button while it's gathering.
- Buttons for Artisan, Gather & Chill and Knightshopper now disappear when that plugin is turned off, and come back when it's on again.
- Knightshopper lists copied from the Tracker are now named like "Relic Tracker - Scrips".
